text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with first / secondly / In my point of view","quality":"organization","description":"This captures the use of a recognizable essay structure that groups ideas into connected paragraphs."},{"evidence":"states a general claim about success and then supports it with reasons","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures the ability to develop a controlling idea with explanations rather than only listing activities."},{"evidence":"uses transition words like \"First,\" \"secondly,\" and \"However\"","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"This captures more effective use of discourse markers to connect sentences and sections of the essay."},{"evidence":"\"never give up on the difficults challenge you have to face in you way to successful life\"","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"This captures greater control of longer, more layered sentences with subordinate ideas."},{"evidence":"\"become successful\",\"critical thinker\",\"positive thought\"","quality":"academic vocabulary","description":"This captures more abstract and school-like word choice for discussing ideas such as success and attitude."}]}
